$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the workspace hibernation settings (plans/cmux-next/workspace-hibernation-DESIGN.md): idle workspaces leave memory. gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants (WorkspaceHibernationSettings parses them). Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: hibernation
lists.note: Settings > General > Hibernation. WorkspaceHibernation (CmuxNextApp) reads both rows; a workspace's Keep Awake (its row's Options menu) wins.

rows.name: enabled
rows.note: On by default (Lawrence 14151: pause idle workspaces and free their memory). Off: nothing hibernates on its own; Hibernate Workspace still works.

help.text: Frees the memory of workspaces you have not used for a while. Terminals and agents keep running; pages and chats come back where they were when you open the workspace.

rows.name: idleMinutes
rows.note: Minutes since the workspace was last shown, printed output, or its agent spoke. 60: an hour away. Memory pressure shortens it (warning 10 minutes, critical 1).

help.text: A workspace hibernates when you have not opened it and nothing in it changed for this many minutes. Pinned workspaces, running commands and agents, and workspaces kept awake never hibernate.
